 This individual will use graph databases, statistical modeling, machine learning, and anomaly detection techniques to analyze relationships between people, organizations, accounts, transactions, devices, addresses, and other entities. The Graph Data Scientist will work closely with fraud investigators, analysts, data engineers, and business stakeholders to transform large volumes of structured and unstructured data into actionable fraud intelligence.
 



  





 The ideal candidate has at least three years of hands\-on experience with Neo4j or a comparable graph database, fluency in Cypher or a similar graph query language, and strong experience applying graph analytics to fraud detection, risk modeling, or investigative use cases.

* Build and maintain graph data models representing people, organizations, accounts, transactions, devices, locations, addresses, and other relevant entities.
* Develop and optimize Cypher queries to explore relationships, identify suspicious connections, and support fraud investigations.
* Apply graph algorithms such as community detection, centrality analysis, similarity scoring, pathfinding, connected components, and link prediction.
* Develop fraud risk models, anomaly detection models, and predictive analytics using Python, machine learning, and statistical techniques.
* Perform entity resolution, data matching, and record linkage across multiple data sources.
* Identify organized fraud networks, shared identifiers, unusual transaction patterns, and indirect relationships between seemingly unrelated entities.
* Combine graph\-derived features with traditional machine learning models to improve fraud detection accuracy.
* Create visual representations of entity relationships and fraud networks for investigators, analysts, and business stakeholders.
* Conduct exploratory data analysis on large, complex, structured, and unstructured datasets.
* Design model testing, validation, and quality\-control processes to ensure analytical outputs are accurate, reliable, explainable, and repeatable.
* Work with data engineering teams to ingest, transform, and structure data for graph analytics.
* Document graph schemas, analytical methodologies, model assumptions, query logic, testing results, and technical recommendations.
* Present findings and complex relationship patterns in a clear, actionable manner to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

* 3\+years of hands\-on experience working with Neo4j or a similar graph database.

* Professional experience using graph analytics to support fraud detection, risk management, financial crime, investigations, cybersecurity, or a related use case.
* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Experience developing risk models, anomaly detection models, predictive models, or machine learning solutions.
* Experience analyzing entity relationships and identifying hidden connections across complex datasets.
* Strong understanding of graph data modeling, nodes, relationships, properties, graph traversal, and graph algorithms.
* Experience with entity resolution, record linkage, data matching, and identity resolution.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
* Experience working with large datasets from multiple internal and external sources.
